scope: Local validation of source metadata, independent citations, URL format, geographic precision fields and mandatory proposal evidence. Does not establish any scientific truth or URL availability.

baseline.summary: Methodological neutral anchor reset from unsupported borrowed 59 to 50; -9 is NOT experimental one-history evidence. Published claim-specific XENONnT model bound recorded in WL-011/MOVE-001; central ontology unresolved.

proposalRules.reviewerGate: check(p,data), record(p,data,review stamp), reverse(prior decision,current score,review stamp) in trusted Node, with real source/notes IDs and reviewed evidence commit SHA; no browser can mutate or auto-approve; nonzero directional revisions require github-approval.cjs API-confirmed distinct human approved review for current PR head SHA; use trusted fetchGitHubApproval, not unchecked reviewer text.
proposalRules.humanReviewVerification: tools/truth-engine/github-approval.cjs verifies actual PR reviewer identity, newest decision, non-author distinction, and exact current evidence commit; synthetic fixtures are not production approval.

historicAudits.rule: Past no-change VC records remain immutable; this array records future scored revisions only. A future revision must reference the previous audit and evidence-bearing repository commit.
